description: Extracts the files from a ZIP file and returns a list of file references. Save them with a Loop and a Create or Update step: this step does not store them in records.
label: UNZIP

options.name: zip-file
options.label: ZIP file
options.info: The ZIP file to extract, for example the file property of a record. Folders inside the ZIP are flattened; macOS metadata files are skipped.

options.name: model-target
options.label: Model to save the extracted files into
options.info: The model of the Create or Update step that saves the extracted files. The file references only fit that model and property.

options.name: property-target
options.label: Property to save the extracted files into
options.info: The file property the extracted files will be saved in. All files go into this one property.

options.name: references
options.label: As
options.info: The file references of the extracted files, in ZIP order. Use a Loop step over them and a Create or Update step to save each file.
